 "data": "gantt
 title CharAI Project High-Level Schedule
 dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
 section Major Milestones

 Engineering Release :milestone, eng, 2026-2-27, 0d

 EXPO :milestone, expo, 2026-4-30, 0d
 section Planning
 Defining Requirements :reqs, 2025-9-7, 30d
 section Architecture & Plan
 UML Diagrams :uml, after reqs, 1w
 Architecture Models :arch, after reqs, 1w
 Milestones/Responsibilities :sresp, after uml arch, 3d
 section Rapid Prototype
 Build Mock UIs :mock, after sresp, 2w
 Core Functionality :core, after sresp, 2w

 section Data
 Build Data Layer :data, after sresp, 4w

 section Model Development
 Define Evaluation Metrics :modl1, after dat4, 1w
 Design CNN Architecture :modl2, after modl1, 1w
 Train Baseline Model :modl3, after modl2, 3w
 Iterate - Evaluate & Tune :modl4, after modl3, 2w
 Select Best Model :modl5, after modl4, 3d
 section MVP
 Deploy CNN Model :mvp, after modl5, 1w
 Get Feedback :fdbck, after mvp, 1w
 section Implementation
 Front-end :frnt, after tprot, 4w
 Back-end :back, after tprot, 6w
 Setup Database :db, after tprot, 3w
 System Integration :sysint, after modl5 frnt back db, 2w
 section Testing & Validation
 Unit Testing :utest, after tprot, 6w
 Integration Testing :itest, after tprot, 6w
 System Testing :stest, after tprot, 6w
 Model Testing :mtest, after modl1, 4w
